message:
The other night, we lost power for a few hours, and at first, I was a bit flustered. I grabbed my trusty flashlight and set up some battery-operated lanterns, but once the essentials were taken care of, I noticed something beautiful happening. Without the TV buzzing or devices pinging, my family and I rediscovered the simple joy of playing board games by lantern light. 

We laughed, shared stories, and even got a little competitive (I might have let my husband win a round or two 😉). It reminded me that sometimes, the best memories are made when we unplug and enjoy each other’s company, even in the dark. 

What’s your favorite way to have fun during a blackout?
